title: Liquidity bot: Logs
description: Sub-page of the Liquidity bot board in the liquidity folder. Level/category/target/search-filterable structured log lines.

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.description: GCP project id — both the Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging queries take it directly.

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.description: The log Category filter: exact-match domain tags the bot's tracing spans set (bridge/broker/cqrs/.../wallet), distinct from crate/module paths.
list.query: bridge, broker, cqrs, dashboard, hedge, inventory, orderbook, rebalance, startup, tokenization, wallet

list.name: search
list.label: Message search
list.description: The free-text search box: regex against jsonPayload.message.

panels.description: The header: settings pills, Config, the CLI recovery guide, the deployed commit, uptime, and whether the bot is up: its scrape's up.

promQLQuery.expr: label_replace(max(up{job="$env"}), "k", "up", "", "") or label_replace(time() - max(liq_bot_start_timestamp_seconds{job="$env"}), "k", "uptime", "", "") or label_replace(max by (git_commit) (timestamp(liq_bot_info{job="$env"})), "k", "commit", "", "") or label_replace(max by (broker, log_level, wallet_kind, wallet_address, orderbook, turnkey_organization, server_port) (timestamp(liq_settings_info{job="$env"})), "k", "info", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_equity_target{job="$env"}), "k", "equity_target", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_equity_deviation{job="$env"}), "k", "equity_deviation", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_usdc_target{job="$env"}), "k", "usdc_target", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_usdc_deviation{job="$env"}), "k", "usdc_deviation", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_execution_threshold_usd{job="$env"}), "k", "trigger", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_cash_reserved{job="$env"}), "k", "cash_reserved", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_order_polling_seconds{job="$env"}), "k", "order_polling", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_inventory_poll_seconds{job="$env"}), "k", "inventory_polling", "", "") or label_replace(max(liq_settings_deployment_block{job="$env"}), "k", "deployment_block", "", "") or label_replace(max by (symbol, chain) (liq_equity_chain_wrapper_ratio{job="$env"}), "k", "wrapper_ratio", "", "")

panels.title: Log History
panels.description: The bot's structured log lines. Filter with the level/category/target/search variables above. ⚠️ Only the newest matching entries, about the panel's pixel width of them. Narrow the filters, or for deep digs run `st0x-liquidity-client --env <production|staging> read resource logs` or use the Grafana Logs export. DEBUG/TRACE are not shown.
